title: The Radial Spanning Tree is straight in all dimensions
summary: The Radial Spanning Tree (RST) in dimension $d\geq2$ is a random geometric graph constructed on a homogeneous Poisson point process $\mathcal N$ in $\mathbb R^d$ augmented by the origin, with edges connecting each $x\in\mathcal N$ to the nearest point $y\in\mathcal N\cup\{0\}$ that lies closer to $0$ than $x$, with respect to the Euclidean distance. By construction, it forms almost surely a tree rooted at $0$.
